notes.title: Recall News Demo — Major Update
notes.content:
Signal updated. The demo version has changed, and new data is now being transmitted.

What’s new:
[olist]
Monster behavior has become more unpredictable. Some reactions can’t be anticipated. There are also new surprises waiting inside.

System anomalies detected. Small, shifting presences appear at the edge of perception, as if coming from within the ship itself.

A new level is now available in the demo. Different corridors, different traps, different reports.

The soundscape has been reworked. Everything is clearer, closer, sharper.

Controls improved. The response is now more precise and reliable.

The Death Level has been updated. It now looks and feels different.

New features added — some obvious, others will reveal themselves later.

Bugs fixed, though the signal remains distorted.
[/olist]
The demo is available now. Check the signal. Record your findings.

notes.title: System Update Deployed — RECALL NEWS DEMO
notes.content:
Command has greenlit another overhaul. If you thought you knew how this worked — think again.

🔧 What’s changed:

• Tutorial Reworked — onboarding is now smoother, faster, and more intuitive for new operatives. Less confusion, more clarity.

• AI System Rebuilt — smarter responses, more believable behavior, and a few… surprises. Don’t assume you’re alone.

• Sound Design Enhanced — ambient layers and effects have been refined. The silence isn’t what it used to be.

• Bugs Fixed — dozens of glitches, visual hiccups, and logic errors eliminated. The system is cleaner, but not necessarily safer.

This version learns faster. Teaches harder.
Enter again — and pay attention this time.

📡 Stay in signal. Stay alert.

notes.title: RECALL NEWS DEMO — SIGNAL UPDATE #2
notes.content:
The zone has shifted again. Behaviors are evolving. Protocols have been patched.

A new update is live for the RECALL NEWS DEMO, bringing refinements to your field experience, improvements under the hood, and one small briefing that might help you survive a little longer.
[hr][/hr]
What’s new:

• Monster AI adjustments — improved movement, pathing, and reactions (they're more curious now — and faster)
• Performance optimizations — smoother experience across all configurations
• Bug fixes — several reported issues neutralized
• New onboarding tutorial — a brief intro to help first-time operatives grasp the basics before they’re dropped in
[hr][/hr]
Command continues to monitor your progress. Your survival helps us improve the system.
Report in. Re-enter. Try not to be seen.

Download the update and continue the test.

notes.title: 🛠 RECALL NEWS DEMO — UPDATE TRANSMITTED
notes.content:
Command has pushed a new build. The zone is shifting.

We’ve rolled out a fresh update for the RECALL NEWS DEMO, featuring performance improvements, interface tweaks, and new content for operatives who think they’ve seen it all. You haven’t.

🔧 What’s changed:

• Performance Optimized — smoother transitions, faster loads, reduced stutter in high-glitch areas

• New Content Added — fresh environmental details and objects to uncover (and question)

• UI Improved — clearer prompts, updated icons, and better flow for first-time operatives

This is still only a glimpse — but now it flickers just a little cleaner.

Return to the test zone. See what’s changed.

Report what you find. Or what finds you.

📡 Stay in signal. Stay alert.
